items.title: 14.9 Link between air quality and human health (air quality aur sehat ka talluq) (Roman Urdu)

source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of topic 14.9 heading, printed page 315.

blocks.text: Air quality aur human health (insani sehat) ka link (talluq) well-documented (achhi tarah sabit) aur bohat important hai. Kharab air quality ke sehat par immediate (foran hone wale) aur long-term (lambe arse ke) effects ho sakte hain. Bare pollutants aur un ke effects 14.9.1 mein hain.

blocks.prompt: Air pollution ke sehat par effects (asar) 'immediate' aur 'long-term' dono kyun kehlate hain?
blocks.explanation: Zyada pollution wala ek din bhi foran aankhon aur saans ki naliyon mein jalan aur asthma ka attack la sakta hai, jabke saalon gandi hawa mein saans lene se aahista aahista bronchitis, dil ki bimari aur cancer ho sakte hain.

items: Kharab air quality ke sehat par immediate aur long-term effects hote hain.
